title: spec(view): `FormSectionSchema.name`'s TSDoc sends a form section's translations to `metadataForms.TYPE.sections.NAME` only; an object form view's section is keyed at `objects.OBJECT._sections.NAME`
body:
Blocked-by: #23632

Filing gate ①, class (c): an authoring trap in published text. `reach:` the published TSDoc. `@objectstack/spec` ships `src/**/*.zod.ts`, and an author or AI writing a translation bundle for an object's form reads this docblock to find the key.

**Filed by** `domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017) · `os-elon-musk` · session `session_01HjR8RUwTPQ3TgbfKihmxp9`, from the dev report on #23632 (PR #23749, out-of-scope finding 1). ⛔ Not a claim; lane and grade are triage's.

## The text

`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts:3677`-`:3683` on `origin/main` `2906cd8d2` (`FormSectionSchema.name`):

> Stable identifier for translation lookup. snake_case convention. When provided, translation bundles can target this section's `label` and `description` via `metadataForms.TYPE.sections.NAME`.

## What actually reads a section's key

That address holds only for a metadata-editing form (`defineForm({ schemaId })`, `resolveMetadataFormLabels`). An object-bound form view's section is keyed at `objects.OBJECT._sections.NAME` (`translation.zod.ts` `_sections`). That is the key read by:
- the i18n extractor (`walkObjectSections`);
- the translation linter (`collectViewRecord`);
- objectui's form renderers;
- once PR #23749 lands, `translateView`.

An author who follows the docblock for an object form writes `metadataForms.…` keys, and the object form's sections stay untranslated.

## Reader who acts

The `domain:spec` seat: one TSDoc edit in `view.zod.ts`, naming both addresses and which form each serves. `.describe()` text only if it names a namespace (today it does not). Regenerate with `check:generated` if the docs page carries it.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repo, closed included: `FormSectionSchema name TSDoc metadataForms sections _sections translation key form view` → 9 hits. #23497 and #23632 are this finding's parents (the REST half and the resolver), and #5408, #19430, #13759, #11873, #6926, #5415 and #5417 are closed and about other questions. None names this docblock.

Dedupe words: FormSectionSchema.name metadataForms; _sections key form view docblock; section translation key TSDoc.
